entries.summaryZh: 1945年7月1日，第二次世界大战太平洋战争末期，澳大利亚第7师在荷属东印度婆罗洲的巴厘巴板附近实施双簧管二号登陆作战，这是盟军解放婆罗洲战役的最后阶段。登陆部队约3.3万人，在猛烈海空火力准备后上岸，夺取港口与两处机场。主要战斗到7月下旬结束，清剿持续至战争结束。
entries.summaryEn: On 1 July 1945, late in the Pacific War, the Australian 7th Division landed near Balikpapan in Borneo as Operation Oboe Two, the concluding stage of the Borneo campaign. About 33,000 Allied troops came ashore after heavy air and naval bombardment and secured the town, its port and two airfields; major operations ended in late July.
entries.significanceZh: 巴厘巴板之战是盟军解放婆罗洲的最后一次主要登陆，夺取的港口与油田设施对战后局势具有价值。
entries.significanceEn: Balikpapan was the last major Allied landing in Borneo and secured port and oil facilities of lasting value.

entries.summaryZh: 2008年3月4日起，亚美尼亚与阿塞拜疆军队在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫接触线一带爆发自1994年停火以来最激烈的交火，双方互相指责对方挑衅。亚美尼亚方面称阿塞拜疆趁亚美尼亚国内选举抗议之机施压。3月14日联合国大会通过决议，要求亚美尼亚军队立即撤出被占领地区。
entries.summaryEn: From 4 March 2008 Armenian and Azerbaijani forces fought the heaviest clashes along the Nagorno-Karabakh line of contact since the 1994 ceasefire, each side blaming the other. Armenian sources accused Azerbaijan of exploiting the election unrest in Yerevan; on 14 March the UN General Assembly adopted a resolution demanding the withdrawal of Armenian forces.
entries.significanceZh: 2008年玛达克冲突打破了纳卡停火后的相对平静，是此后冲突升级的前奏。
entries.significanceEn: The 2008 Mardakert clashes broke the relative calm after the 1994 ceasefire and foreshadowed later escalation.

entries.summaryZh: 2010年，亚美尼亚与阿塞拜疆军队在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫接触线沿线发生一系列违反停火事件，双方互相指责对方破坏停火。这是1994年停火以来最严重的违规之一，亚美尼亚方面的伤亡为2008年玛达克冲突以来最重。事件显示纳卡问题在两年内再度升温。
entries.summaryEn: In 2010 Armenian and Azerbaijani forces exchanged a series of ceasefire violations along the Nagorno-Karabakh line of contact, each side accusing the other. They were the worst violations since the 1994 ceasefire and left Armenian forces with their heaviest casualties since the Mardakert clashes of March 2008, showing how quickly the conflict was heating up again.
entries.significanceZh: 2010年马尔达凯特冲突表明纳卡停火机制持续失效，为2016年与2020年的大规模交战埋下伏笔。
entries.significanceEn: The 2010 clashes showed the ceasefire was steadily eroding and foreshadowed the larger fighting of 2016 and 2020.

entries.summaryZh: 1884年3月13日，英国军队在杰拉尔德·格雷厄姆爵士指挥下于苏丹塔迈尔与奥斯曼·迪格纳率领的马赫迪军队交战。英军此前在埃尔泰卜取胜，此番再度击败马赫迪军，但自身也遭受不小损失。此役是英国在苏丹东部一系列作战中的一环，未能阻止马赫迪运动继续壮大。
entries.summaryEn: On 13 March 1884 a British force under Sir Gerald Graham fought the Mahdist army of Osman Digna at Tamai in Sudan. The British had already won at El Teb and defeated the Mahdists again here, though at considerable cost to themselves; the battle was one of a series in eastern Sudan and did not stop the Mahdist movement's growth.
entries.significanceZh: 塔迈尔之战虽为英军取胜，却未能扭转苏丹战局，马赫迪运动此后继续扩张。
entries.significanceEn: Tamai was a British victory that failed to change the course of the Sudan campaign, and the Mahdist movement continued to expand.

entries.summaryZh: 1900年2月18日，第二次布尔战争期间，英军在金伯利以东的帕德伯格附近遭受开战以来最惨重的单日损失，这一天被英方称为血腥星期日。此前英军多次进攻布尔阵地未果，当日战斗再次失利，伤亡惨重。这一挫败促使英军调整指挥与战术，并加速了后续大规模增援。
entries.summaryEn: On 18 February 1900, during the Second Boer War, British forces suffered their heaviest single day of casualties of the war so far near Paardeberg east of Kimberley, a day the British called Bloody Sunday. Repeated attacks on the Boer position had failed and the fighting again went badly, prompting changes in command and a larger reinforcement effort.
entries.significanceZh: 血腥星期日是英军在布尔战争中最惨重的单日损失之一，直接影响了此后的指挥与战术调整。
entries.significanceEn: Bloody Sunday was one of the heaviest single days of British losses in the Boer War and forced changes in command and tactics.

entries.summaryZh: 1914年11月23日至1915年2月6日，第一次世界大战西线，英军在法比佛兰德地区进行冬季作战，包括对伊瑟河与伊普尔周边的持续攻防。此前德军在伊瑟河与第一次伊普尔战役中未能突破，双方转入阵地战。这一阶段的作战被英国官方战史命名为冬季行动，标志西线运动战彻底结束。
entries.summaryEn: From 23 November 1914 to 6 February 1915 the British Expeditionary Force conducted winter operations in French and Belgian Flanders, including continued fighting around the Yser and Ypres. After the German failure at the Yser and the First Battle of Ypres the front congealed into trench warfare, and the official British nomenclature named this phase the winter operations.
entries.significanceZh: 冬季行动标志西线运动战的终结与堑壕战的形成，为此后数年的消耗战定型。
entries.significanceEn: The winter operations marked the end of mobile warfare on the Western Front and the beginning of the trench stalemate.

entries.summaryZh: 1914年9月1日，第一次世界大战蒙斯撤退期间，英军一个骑兵旅在法国内里村宿营后遭德军一个骑兵师突袭。英军L炮兵连一门火炮在多数火炮被毁后仍坚持射击两个半小时，随后赶到的援军反击并击退德军。该连三人因此获维多利亚十字勋章，火炮连后来获得内里荣誉称号。
entries.summaryEn: On 1 September 1914, during the Great Retreat from Mons, a British cavalry brigade was surprised at its bivouac at Nery in France by a German cavalry division. One gun of L Battery kept firing for two and a half hours after the others were knocked out, and reinforcements arriving around 8 a.m. counter-attacked and routed the Germans.
entries.significanceZh: 内里事件以炮兵连的顽强抵抗闻名，是蒙斯撤退中英军少数成功的后卫作战之一。
entries.significanceEn: Nery is remembered for the stubbornness of a single artillery battery and was one of the few successful British rearguard actions of the retreat from Mons.

entries.titleEn: Battle of the Ascent of Lebonah
entries.summaryZh: 公元前167年或前166年，马加比起义最初阶段，犹大·马加比率少量游击队伍在从撒马利亚通往耶路撒冷的勒波纳坡道伏击阿波罗尼乌斯率领的撒马利亚军队并将其击败。这是马加比人对外作战的首场胜利，见于马加比一书开头。战役的确切地点与日期均无定论。
entries.summaryEn: In 167 or 166 BCE, at the very start of the Maccabean revolt, Judas Maccabeus and a small guerrilla band ambushed and defeated the Samaritan force of Apollonius on the ascent of Lebonah on the road from Samaria to Jerusalem. It was the Maccabees' first victory over a foreign army; neither the site nor the date is certain.
entries.significanceZh: 勒波纳坡道之战是马加比起义的首场胜利，为随后一系列反抗塞琉古的作战开了先例。
entries.significanceEn: The ascent of Lebonah was the first Maccabean victory and set the pattern for the revolt against the Seleucids.

entries.summaryZh: 公元485年，据《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》记载，撒克逊首领埃勒率军在莫克雷德斯伯恩与不列颠人交战，这是埃勒在苏塞克斯建立王国的三场战役之一。编年史记其前有477年的西门斯霍雷之战、后有491年的佩文西之战。此役的确切地点与规模已不可考，是南撒克逊王国起源传说的一部分。
entries.summaryEn: In 485 CE, according to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, the Saxon leader Aelle fought the Britons at Mercredesburne, one of the three battles by which he established the kingdom of the South Saxons, after Cymenshore in 477 and before Pevensey in 491. The site and scale of the battle are unknown and it survives in the foundation story of Sussex.
entries.significanceZh: 莫克雷德斯伯恩之战是南撒克逊王国建立传说的一环，也是早期苏塞克斯历史的少数文献线索之一。
entries.significanceEn: Mercredesburne belongs to the foundation story of the South Saxons and is one of the few documentary traces of early Sussex.

entries.summaryZh: 1917年11月13日，第一次世界大战西奈与巴勒斯坦战役的追击阶段，埃及远征军在南巴勒斯坦的莫卧儿岭，即英方所称的埃尔穆加尔行动中，与撤退中的奥斯曼军队交战。英军骑兵在胡杰实施冲锋，随后攻占莫卧儿岭一线，奥斯曼军队继续北撤，为英军进军耶路撒冷打开通路。
entries.summaryEn: On 13 November 1917, during the pursuit phase of the Sinai and Palestine campaign of the First World War, the Egyptian Expeditionary Force fought the retreating Ottoman army at Mughar Ridge in southern Palestine, an action the British called El Mughar. A yeomanry charge at Huj preceded the capture of the ridge, opening the way for the advance on Jerusalem.
entries.significanceZh: 莫卧儿岭之战打开了英军进军耶路撒冷的通路，是西奈与巴勒斯坦战役后期的关键一战。
entries.significanceEn: Mughar Ridge opened the way to Jerusalem and was a key action in the later stages of the Sinai and Palestine campaign.
